purpose: Integrate the unified qualified target portfolio, authenticated multimodal evidence and existing EMA mechanics without forcing one monolithic target, one teacher or one student, and without forcing partial RNA to reproduce teacher-private biology.

scientific_model.target_portfolio: Z_shared ⊕ Z_query ⊕ Z_rel_if_qualified ⊕ eligible specialist blocks ⊕ support/uncertainty
scientific_model.rare_biology: cross-cutting regime within these same blocks, not a separate TD branch
scientific_model.teacher_state: qualified shared biological core plus teacher-specific query/relational/regulatory/context adapters and teacher-private privileged components
scientific_model.student_point_target: only qualified RNA-recoverable components of each active block
forbidden_point_target: exact realized ATAC state when not RNA-identifiable
exact realized spatial neighborhood when not RNA-identifiable
scientific_model.principle: Different biological aspects may require different target blocks and evidence-specialized teachers/heads; overlapping biology should share a constrained core rather than form independent unconstrained latent universes.

foundation_target_binding.C2: Z_rel candidate only if corrected replay keeps C2 active
foundation_target_binding.C6: possible fused Z_shared+Z_query implementation subject to C1+C3 and C6 increment
foundation_target_binding.C4: possible fused Z_shared+Z_query+Z_rel implementation only if constituents qualify
foundation_target_binding.C5: regulatory specialist only; never foundation rescue

teacher_family.T_SHARED_RNA: rich lawful RNA teacher for shared/global biology
teacher_family.T_QUERY: query-conditioned teacher using rich same-cell evidence and proving contextual information beyond query scalar/identity
teacher_family.T_RELATIONAL: relational teacher only if C2 remains active
teacher_family.T_REGULATORY_MULTIOME: privileged same-nucleus RNA+ATAC/regulatory teacher after target/program freeze
teacher_family.implementation_rule: Prefer shared biological core plus teacher-specific adapters/heads where biology overlaps; do not duplicate whole teachers merely to satisfy naming symmetry.

student_family.default: one full-capacity shared student/online backbone with block-specific heads/experts
student_family.S_QUERY: predicts q-conditioned block from q-safe partial RNA plus query identity
student_family.S_RELATIONAL: predicts recoverable relational block if qualified
student_family.S_REGULATORY: predicts recoverable regulatory component plus calibrated uncertainty
student_family.S_SUPPORT_UNCERTAINTY: support, biological uncertainty, measurement uncertainty and abstention
separate_full_student_only_if: stable negative transfer between qualified blocks
student_family.forbidden_default: no half-capacity dual-student default and no architecture zoo

regular_and_rare_program_modeling.rule: Common, continuous, intermediate-frequency and rare biology are evaluated within the same active target blocks and the same multimodal reconciliation pathway.
regular_and_rare_program_modeling.freeze_rule: Freeze RNA target geometry/program/state/query/relational definitions before deciding multimodal outcomes are opened.

teacher_behavior.rna_biology_without_privileged_increment: retain qualified RNA biology without inventing privileged state
teacher_behavior.multimodal_falsifier: interpretation failure only; no retrospective target rewrite

questions: For each qualified target block, does ATAC/regulatory evidence support, sharpen, split or falsify the frozen RNA interpretation without redefining it?
Which privileged increments are donor-held-out predictable from RNA?
Do different blocks interfere when jointly represented?
Are increments robust to depth/source/support/query controls as applicable?

ema_integration.runtime_reuse: Reuse canonical V5 AdamW->successful-update->EMA mechanics; no second EMA engine.
ema_integration.ema_shared_core: EMA stabilizes structurally shared teacher/student modules.
ema_integration.privileged_adapters: ATAC/regulatory/spatial teacher adapters may be teacher-only.
ema_integration.failed_update_rule: no optimizer completion means no EMA advance

loss_family.shared_state_loss: rotation/subspace-aware deterministic matching on recoverable shared blocks
loss_family.joint_interference_control: required when multiple blocks are trained together

hard_prohibitions: No forced single target winner when complementary blocks qualify.
No exact student matching of teacher-private biology.
No source/operator identity as biological state.
No zero-fill for missing privileged evidence.
No C5/multimodal rescue of failed foundation.
No multimodal retrospective redefinition of frozen RNA biology.
No architecture zoo without demonstrated biological non-redundancy or negative transfer.
No real training authority from this file.
